## Update 3 — Loading State Ticker

Replace the generic "Running focus group..." spinner with an animated message ticker. Show this full-screen (or centered in the page) while all AI roast calls are running.

**Messages to cycle (2.5 seconds each, fade between):**
1. "The YC Partner is reading your deck..."
2. "The Devil's Advocate found something..."
3. "The panel is reviewing your market sizing..."
4. "Three personas have flagged the same slide..."
5. "The panel is convening on a verdict..."
6. "Finalising the scores..."

**Style:**
- Centered on the `#F5F0E6` background
- Gold `#C9A84C` italic serif text, 20px
- A small gavel emoji or rotating gold circle (14px, border: 2px solid #C9A84C, border-right-color: transparent, animation: spin 1s linear infinite) to the left of the text
- Below the text, a thin gold progress bar 280px wide that fills from left to right over 20 seconds
- Fade transition between messages: 0.35s fade out, 0.35s fade in on the new message

## Update 4 — Meet the Panel Interstitial

After all AI roast calls complete and before Screen 2 renders, show a full-screen "Meet the Panel" interstitial. This is a two-phase animation.

**Trigger:** fires automatically when `all_roast_outputs` is fully populated. The user does not click anything to trigger it.

**Phase 1 — Intro text (2.4 seconds, then exits by translating up and fading out):**

Dark navy `#0C1525` full-screen background. Thin gold corner bracket decorations at all four corners (40×40px, 1px `#C9A84C` border, only the two sides of each corner drawn). A radial gold glow from the center `radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 50% 50%, rgba(201,168,76,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%)`.

Centered content, stacked vertically, each element appearing with a `translateY(16px) → translateY(0)` + `opacity 0 → 1` animation:
- 0.1s delay: `"Your document has been reviewed"` — 10px, `#C9A84C`, letter-spacing 0.55em, uppercase
- 0.3s delay: `"Meet The Panel"` — 60px, bold, `'EB Garamond'` or Georgia, cream `#F5F0E6`. The word "Panel" is italic and colored `#E8C97A`
- 0.55s delay: A 70px wide horizontal rule, `background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #C9A84C, transparent)`, height 1px
- 0.7s delay: `"5 professionals. One verdict."` — 15px, `#8899AA`, italic

**Phase 2 — Persona cards (visible from 2.8s onwards):**

Same dark navy background. Panel label centered at top: e.g. `"SEED INVESTORS PANEL"` — 10px, `#C9A84C`, letter-spacing 0.5em, uppercase. Appears at 3.0s.

A horizontal row of 5 persona cards, centered, each 165px wide, 14px gaps. Cards are dark `#152035` background, 1px `rgba(201,168,76,0.18)` border, 10px border-radius, with box-shadow `0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)`.

Each card rises staggered from `translateY(36px) scale(0.96) opacity:0` to `translateY(0) scale(1) opacity:1` using `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)` easing:
- Card 1: 3.1s
- Card 2: 3.28s
- Card 3: 3.46s
- Card 4: 3.64s
- Card 5: 3.82s

**Each persona card layout:**
- Top section (140px tall): persona image on `#000` background, `object-fit: contain`, `object-position: bottom center`. A gradient fade at the bottom: `linear-gradient(0deg, #152035, transparent)` overlaid.
- Body section (padding 13px):
  - Name: 13px, bold, EB Garamond, `#F5F0E6`
  - Role: 9.5px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.07em, `#C9A84C`, margin-bottom 9px
  - Divider: 1px, `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(201,168,76,0.28), transparent)`
  - Description: 11px, italic, `#8899AA`, line-height 1.5

**Hover state on cards:** `translateY(-7px) scale(1.04)`, border-color `rgba(201,168,76,0.45)`, box-shadow `0 16px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 0 28px rgba(201,168,76,0.1)`.

**"See the verdict →" button** appears at 4.5s with fade-up animation. Style: transparent background, 1px `rgba(201,168,76,0.38)` border, 5px border-radius, `10px 38px` padding, EB Garamond 12px, letter-spacing 0.22em, uppercase, `#C9A84C` text. Pulsing box-shadow animation every 2.5s. On click: fade the interstitial to opacity 0 over 0.5s, then navigate to Screen 2 with the report data.

Load the correct panel based on `audience_category` stored in the session:
- `Seed Investors` → show seed panel (5 personas)
- `Enterprise Buyers` → show enterprise panel (5 personas)
- `Hiring Managers at Tech Companies` → show hiring panel (5 personas)
- `Series A Investors` → show series A panel (4 personas, adjust layout to 4 cards centered)

## Update 5 — Score Reveal Animation

On Screen 2, replace the static score display with an animated reveal sequence. This fires once when Screen 2 first loads after the Meet the Panel interstitial.

**Sequence:**

1. Screen 2 starts fully `opacity: 0`
2. 0.0s: Background fades in to `#F5F0E6`
3. 0.3s: A centered score reveal element appears: the score number starts at `0.0` and counts up to the actual score (e.g. `6.0`) over 1.8 seconds. Use `requestAnimationFrame` or a CSS counter animation. The number is displayed at 96px, bold, EB Garamond.
4. The number color transitions as it counts: `#16A34A` (green) while below 5.0, `#D97706` (amber) while 5.0–6.9, `#DC2626` (red) if landing below 5.0, `#D97706` (amber) if landing 5.0–7.4, `#16A34A` (green) if landing 7.5+.
5. 2.1s: The verdict sentence fades in below the score, one word at a time with 60ms between words. 16px, italic, `#8899AA`.
6. 3.0s: The persona cards row slides up from `translateY(30px)` into position, staggered 120ms between cards.
7. 3.8s: The rest of Screen 2 (Points of Consensus, Before/After, Enter the Room button) fades in together.

Do not repeat this animation if the user scrolls or navigates back to Screen 2 within the same session.

## Update 7 — Markdown Rendering Fix

In the defence round chat on Screen 3, strip all raw markdown before rendering AI responses. Apply these replacements to every panel response before inserting it into the chat:

- `**text**` → render as `<strong>text</strong>` (bold)
- `*text*` → render as `<em>text</em>` (italic)
- Remove any remaining single or double asterisks that are not part of valid bold/italic pairs

Each persona's response block in the chat should be visually distinct:
- Persona name as a bold label in `#C9A84C` at the top of their block
- A thin left border in a colour associated with that persona (cycle through: `#C9A84C`, `#0D9488`, `#8B5CF6`, `#EF4444`, `#3B82F6` for the 5 personas)
- Their response text below in `rgba(245,240,230,0.9)`, 13px, EB Garamond, line-height 1.6
- 12px gap between each persona block

## Update 8 — "Run Again" Button

On Screen 4 (Panel Card), add a button below the Copy Link button:

**Label:** `"See how [next panel name] would react →"`

Logic: if the current session used `Seed Investors`, show `"See how Enterprise Buyers would react →"`. If `Enterprise Buyers`, show `"See how Hiring Managers would react →"`. If `Hiring Managers`, show `"See how Series A Investors would react →"`. If `Series A Investors`, show `"See how Seed Investors would react →"`.

On click: keep the same `extracted_document_text` from the current session. Load Screen 1 with the next audience category pre-selected and the document pre-loaded. The user only needs to confirm the harshness level and click Run Focus Group.

**Style:** outline button, `#C9A84C` border, `#C9A84C` text, transparent background. 12px, letter-spacing 0.15em, uppercase.
